summary.oneLiner: A 160-year-old diversified Wadia Group company with three manufacturing divisions: tea plantations, auto electric components (Electromags), and dental healthcare products.
summary.business: The Bombay Burmah Trading Corporation Limited operates in three distinct manufacturing segments. The Plantation division cultivates and sells tea, primarily from South Indian estates. The Auto Electric Components division (Electromags) manufactures starter motor assemblies, switches, solenoid valves, and plastic assembled parts for automotive OEMs. The Healthcare division (Dental Products of India) produces and sells dental products to professionals across India.

risks.risk: Margin compression from OEM pricing pressure
risks.note: Intense competition and pricing pressure from OEMs in high-volume auto segments may erode profitability despite operational efficiencies.

risks.risk: Rapid technological change and product obsolescence
risks.note: Accelerated shift toward electrification, digitalisation, and software integration shortens product life cycles and increases risk of obsolescence in auto electronic components.

risks.risk: Availability and retention of skilled talent in electronics and software
risks.note: Shortage of skilled workforce in electronics, software, and system integration could constrain growth and innovation in the Electromags division.

risks.risk: Fragmented dental market with price sensitivity and limited insurance coverage
risks.note: Intense competition, price sensitivity, and low insurance penetration for dental procedures exert structural margin pressure on the Dental Division.

risks.risk: Uneven preventive awareness and high cost of advanced dental technologies
risks.note: Limited awareness of preventive oral care and high cost of advanced technologies pose structural challenges to market expansion in dental products.

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- Tea: Improvements in harvesting and efficiencies reduced total operational expenses, resulting in higher sales revenue despite a 16% drop in overall production.
- Dental: Sustained demand across key product categories, improved focus on value-led products and customer retention, and continued cost discipline and operational efficiencies.
- Auto Electromags: Structurally positive outlook driven by EV adoption, electronics-heavy vehicle architecture, and India's positioning as a global sourcing hub for components.

capital_allocation.title: Strategy & capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- Enhancing land productivity through integrated nutrient management combining conventional fertilizers with organic inputs to improve soil structure and plant resilience.
- Reducing dependence on chemical fertilizers by shifting to bio-fertilizers and organic amendments to restore soil health and lower input costs.
- Investing in factory automation to reduce operational costs, enhance consistency, improve product safety and quality, and mitigate labour dependency.
- Expanding into retail tea sales to capture higher margins, strengthen brand positioning, and increase average realization per unit sold.
- The Corporation has adopted a Dividend Distribution Policy in accordance with Regulation 43A of the Listing Regulations, available on its website.
- BRSR Core assurance obtained for FY 2025-26 from TÃœV SÃœD South Asia Private Limited in accordance with SEBI circulars.
- Zero-tolerance policy on sexual harassment with Internal Committee constituted; zero complaints received, disposed, or pending during the year.
- Compliance with Maternity Benefit Act, 1961 confirmed for the year under review.
- CSR Committee constituted with three directors including one Independent Director; CSR Policy in accordance with Companies (CSR Policy) Rules, 2014.

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: The Corporation has not disclosed any new major capacity expansion or greenfield project with a commissioning timeline in the annual report. The auto electric components business (Electromags) mentions 'selective capacity expansion' as part of its operational performance discussion, but no specific project name, capacity quantum, or completion date is provided. The tea division sold the Dunsandle Estate during the year, indicating a portfolio rationalization rather than expansion. No other capex projects with timelines are described.

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- Diversified portfolio across tea, auto components, and dental products reducing dependence on a single sector.
- Strong brand and long-standing channel relationships in dental division.
- Tea division achieves higher average selling price (~Rs.33.86/kg above average South Indian prices) indicating quality or brand premium.
- Established OEM relationships in auto components with customers like Sona BLW, Brakes India, Hero Motocorp, TVS Motors, ZF-AG, Lucas TVS.
- Part of the reputed Wadia Group, providing institutional credibility and access to a network of subsidiaries including Britannia Industries.

- Margin compression from OEM pricing pressure — Intense competition and pricing pressure from OEMs in high-volume auto segments may erode profitability despite operational efficiencies.
- Rapid technological change and product obsolescence — Accelerated shift toward electrification, digitalisation, and software integration shortens product life cycles and increases risk of obsolescence in auto electronic components.
- Availability and retention of skilled talent in electronics and software — Shortage of skilled workforce in electronics, software, and system integration could constrain growth and innovation in the Electromags division.
- Fragmented dental market with price sensitivity and limited insurance coverage — Intense competition, price sensitivity, and low insurance penetration for dental procedures exert structural margin pressure on the Dental Division.
- Uneven preventive awareness and high cost of advanced dental technologies — Limited awareness of preventive oral care and high cost of advanced technologies pose structural challenges to market expansion in dental products.
